name: Blessed By The Stars scatters stars from a Silverstream heal on a full-health ally
contract: Blessed By The Stars 704741: "casting Silverstream now applies Scattered Stars on up to 5 enemies around
each target healed". The Silverstream branch of OnSpellHitResult tested the effective heal, which is 0 for
a target at full health, so a heal that landed but healed nothing scattered no stars. It now tests the heal
Uses rank 5 (575051), the last rank in the spell_ranks chain that the talent test (Named 575039) matches.
Control: without the talent, a Silverstream on the same full-health ally leaves no Scattered Stars on the
enemy next to it. With the talent, the same cast puts Scattered Stars on that enemy.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the ally is at full health, so any heal on them is all overheal
CONTROL: Silverstream on the full-health ally, no talent
CONTROL: without Blessed By The Stars the enemy has no Scattered Stars
SETUP: Blessed By The Stars is active
Silverstream on the full-health ally, with the talent
DISCRIMINATING: the enemy beside the overhealed ally carries Scattered Stars
